results.title: 'Failures, incompetence, broken promises': Deutsche Bank exposed in major leak
results.content: PRESS REVIEW – Wednesday, November 18: A joint investigation following the leak of 15 million documents shows that Deutsche Bank turned a blind eye to the criminal activities of some of its clients. Next, for its 175th birthday, The New York Times has chosen the top 10 stories that made history. Wired is focusing on the moments that defined 2026. Finally, we bring you a story about American parents whose children dream of becoming Formula 1 drivers. But how much does that dream cost?

results.title: Russia, China look to deepen ties at APEC as Trump arrives
results.content: China's leader Xi Jinping urged closer political and military ties between his country and Russia, as he met with President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Wednesday on the sidelines of the APEC summit. It comes as Donald Trump arrives in China for trilateral talks with Xi and Putin.

results.title: Turkish pro-opposition broadcaster taken off air after police raid
results.content: Turkish authorities took pro-opposition Sozcu TV off air in a pre-dawn raid on Tuesday and appointed a trustee to run the channel and its website, prosecutors said, extending a crackdown on the opposition and renewing concerns about media freedom.

results.title: US loses measles-free status as cases soar
results.content: The United States lost its hard-fought measles elimination status after 26 years, the Pan American Health Organization said on Tuesday, as the country failed to curb the continuous spread of the highly contagious virus for more than a year. Bolivia and Mexico have also lost their measles elimination status, the Americas arm of the World Health Organization said.

results.title: Banks, flights, email… What’s behind series of US tech outages?
results.content: US Secretary of State Marco insisted Wednesday that authorities have found "zero evidence" that recent outages across tech platforms are related to one another or due to the work of "nefarious actors." It follows multiple disruptions of everything from US air traffic operations to Microsoft email and messaging to banking and mobile pay. France 24’s Philip Turle takes a closer look.

results.title: Evacuations on the rise in eastern Ukraine as fighting intensifies
results.content: Civilian evacuations are stepping up in eastern Ukraine as fighting intensifies in the Donetsk region. According to figures released by Ukrainian authorities, more than 6,300 residents left the region in the first ten days of November. . In neighbouring Kharkiv region, hundreds of evacuees arrive every day in the city Lozova, many of whom have lost everything.

results.title: US hits out at Ukraine's 'deep strikes' against Russia in rift with EU over war tactics
results.content: Top US defence official Elbridge Colby criticised Ukraine's "deep strikes" against Russia Tuesday, as President Volodymyr Zelensky urged Kyiv's backers to send air defences without delay. His comments, delivered at a gathering of Ukraine's allies in Brussels, was flat out rejected by both Germany and the United Kingdom, who hit back at the Americans' suggestion.

results.title: EU proposes new €45 billion Ukraine loan to be repaid by Russia
results.content: European Commission President Ursula von ⁠der Leyen announced on Wednesday a proposed €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027 to help cover around two-thirds ​of Kyiv's financing ​needs. The loan will be repaid ⁠through future ⁠war reparations by Russia, von der Leyen added.

results.title: Nvidia posts blockbuster quarterly results amid leadership crisis
results.content: AI chipmaker Nvidia posted Q3 revenues double those of last year and 20 percent higher than last quarter, while the company board says it has no intention of reinstating disgraced former CEO Jensen Huang. Also in this edition: gaming tourists flock to Miami amid a marketing blitz for the upcoming release of the latest edition in the "Grand Theft Auto" franchise.

results.title: Trump says ‘taking seriously’ reports Iran planning Washington dirty-bomb attack
results.content: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday the US was taking seriously the possibility that Iran could be planning an attack involving a so-called dirty bomb in Washington, after ‌being asked about a CNN ⁠report citing US intelligence assessments. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson denied the allegations in a post on X on Tuesday, calling them "baseless."

results.title: 'All eyes on talks with Putin, Xi' as Trump arrives at APEC summit
results.content: US President Donald Trump arrived in China on Wednesday where the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit is taking place. However, all eyes will be on a historic trilateral meeting between Trump Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin on Thursday. Trump has said that the talks would cover the wars in Iran and Ukraine as well as nuclear disarmament.

Italy approves anti-semitism law despite concerns over freedom of expression
results.content: Italy's ​parliament on Tuesday approved a new bill aimed at combating anti-semitism – which lists some forms of criticism of ⁠Israel as examples of anti-semitic conduct – despite concerns that it could limit freedom of expression and advocacy for Palestinian rights. The law will not impose financial ⁠penalties or criminal sanctions for offenders.

results.title: AFCON 2027 qualifiers: Senegal and five other nations secure spot
results.content: The first teams to qualify for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations have been decided. Senegal, Cameroon and Morocco are among them.

results.title: Peltola defeats Sullivan in Alaska Senate race, expanding Democratic majority
Peltola defeats Sullivan in Alaska Senate race, expanding Democratic majority
results.content: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska on Tuesday, completing a political comeback in a state that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly won by wide margins. Her victory gives Democrats a 56-44 Senate majority, marking their biggest net gain in Senate seats since 1958.

results.title: Xi Jinping calls for global cooperation on AI and free trade at APEC summit
results.content: Chinese President Xi Jinping called on Wednesday for stronger global cooperation on artificial intelligence and free trade, as he opened the APEC summit in Shenzhen ahead of an expected meeting with US President Donald Trump. Trade tensions and new US chip export restrictions are set to feature prominently.

results.title: 'Taylor Swift of games': Grand Theft Auto is back after 13-year wait
results.content: "Grand Theft Auto" will be available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles on Thursday after 13 years of waiting, two delays and several leaks. The global gaming phenomenon – dubbed the "Taylor Swift of games" – is the most expensive video game ever developed, and it is on track to break sales records.

results.title: Haitians rally behind Bukele as Salvadoran troops battle gangs
results.content: Thousands of Haitians took to the streets on Tuesday to urge El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele to keep fighting gangs, as his troops bolster security forces in the Caribbean nation. But experts warn that growing public support could turn to anger without a long-term plan to tackle violence and strengthen Haiti's police.

results.title: Trump arrives in China ahead of historic three-way summit with Putin, Xi
results.content: US President Donald Trump arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of a high-stakes trilateral summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin and China's leader Xi Jinging on Thursday. The meeting has sparked fears that the three men could decide the fate of Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv and Europe, and seek to carve up the world into 21st-century spheres of influence.

results.title: Middle East live: Tehran warns of 'more devastating' response to attacks on Iran
results.content: Iran's army chief Amir Hatami said on Wednesday that his country will retaliate in a “more devastating” manner if the United States and its allies launch new attacks on its territory. Earlier that day, Iran's official IRNA news agency reported that Washington had hit Qeshm Island without causing serious damage, while Kuwait and Bahrain said that they intercepted hostile strikes. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

results.title: Nvidia board rules that co-founder Jensen Huang will not return as CEO
results.content: Nvidia's board chairman ruled out bringing back co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO on Tuesday, as the chipmaker forecast stronger-than-expected quarterly sales but faced growing questions over its leadership, national security exposure and long-term strategy following his abrupt departure.

results.title: WHO sounds the alarm on antimicrobial resistance threat
results.content: The spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is threatening modern medicine despite progress in combating drug-resistant bacteria, senior World Health Organization officials said on Monday. WHO officials said countries had expanded efforts to tackle AMR, but warned that progress in prevention, diagnosis and the appropriate use of antibiotics remained too slow to meet global targets. FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Jean Pierre Nyemazi, acting director of the WHO's AMR Department.
